new.statement: Young games selling cosmetic passes (trails, emotes, skins, tags) climb Top Trending faster than games of similar age without them
Young games with text-ad thumbnails climb Top Trending more slowly than games of similar age
Young games published by a group hold higher Top Trending positions than solo-developer games of similar age
Young survival-framed games (survive the nights, zombies) climb Top Trending faster than games of similar age
Young games with servers above 24 players hold lower Top Trending positions than games of similar age with smaller servers
Games framed around rolls, RNG or luck rank lower on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
All-caps titles rank lower on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
Tower-defense loops earn a higher Top Earning position for their CCU than other profiled loops

qualitative_updates.note: The top six held the exact same order as yesterday (Steal An Egg, Brookhaven, DONT SPLASH, 99 Nights, Murder Mystery 2, RIVALS) while moves of 12-28 places happened below.
123-365-day games sit at the 31st median percentile against the 56th for multi-year evergreens and the 47th for 15-42-day games, the third day running.
Throw Food For Animals (+128) and Realistic Ragdoll Engine (+75) climbed Top Earning fast while still among the four least efficient games, consistent with revenue catching up with players.
Top Earning efficiency rises steadily with age (1st percentile at 0-14 days to 60th past a year) while Up-and-Coming favours 0-14-day games (66th).
The Hollow fell off Top Trending and Banana Eats [HOLLOW] dropped 59 places there, suggesting the event lift ends with the event window.
Realistic Ragdoll Engine rose 75 on Top Earning and Ragdoll Playground rose 40 on Up-and-Coming and entered Top Trending; 'Ragdoll' titles go with higher Up-and-Coming positions (r=+0.31).
DONT SPLASH holds #3 on Most Popular and a top-three Up-and-Coming spot at 13 days.
